value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes San Bernardino.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Eligibility Checklist for Expedited Residential Solar Permitting
Hard copies of plans (11x17), specifications, calculations, and job card
Notarized authorization letter (if signed by contractor representative)

value: Legible site maps (11x14), single-line diagrams, specification sheets (8x11), inspection checklists, and job cards must be onsite in hard-copy format during inspection

value.notes: Permit processing for expedited/streamlined application types may take approximately 1-3 business days, depending on staff availability; standard review may take longer.

value.program_or_pathway: SB 379 streamlined permitting (Symbium); expedited review for systems 10kW and under
other_conditions: Systems under 38.4kW qualify for streamlined permitting under SB 379
Systems 10kW and under may qualify for expedited review if they meet the Eligibility Checklist for Expedited Residential Solar Permitting
Electric panel upgrades require separate permits through the Solar Division
